about: Plants and fungi that are poisonous to people. A place may mark one as food when animals really eat it, but then the plant must warn people (plant.<id>.warning and about_safety in locale/en/plants.json); the game shows them with a look-but-don't-pick warning. Matched by GBIF taxon ID (tools/taxon.py). Anyone may propose an addition in a pull request; entries are never removed, and the gate closes a pull request that takes one out.
